title: Conflict finder
subtitle: Find the plugin or theme that broke a page

errors.pollGaveUp: Reading the check's status failed several times — the check is still running on the site, and you can try again.

liveWarning.title: This check runs on the live site
liveWarning.body: Plugins are switched off and back on in groups to find the culprit. A visitor who arrives mid-check sees the site in that state. At the end everything — even if an error occurs — is returned to how it was. It's best run during low-traffic hours.

form.expect: Text that should appear when the page is healthy
form.expectHint: Without this, only the status code is checked — a page that returns 200 but is empty counts as healthy.
form.forbidHint: PHP errors often come back with status 200. If you put the error text here, the page counts as broken whenever it appears.

result.themeIsCause: With the default theme “{compared}” the page worked — so the theme “{current}” is the culprit.
result.themeNotCause: With the default theme “{compared}” the page stayed broken, so the theme “{current}” is not the culprit.
result.bisectBody_one: The culprit was found in {count} step. At each step half the plugins were switched off and the rest stayed on — so a conflict between two plugins stays reproducible.
result.bisectBody_other: The culprit was found in {count} steps. At each step half the plugins were switched off and the rest stayed on — so a conflict between two plugins stays reproducible.
result.restored: Active plugins and theme were read back and match the original state. Page status after restore: {state}.
result.notRestored: Restore didn't complete — check the site manually. {error}
